opening.argument: The presentation promotes an app-based earning opportunity through a registration link, task rewards, commissions, and a stated daily return. Its task-earning title and orders screen frame the activity as a way to earn, while the app advertises a commission reward program. The flow also asks viewers to provide bank account information and associates recharging with interest or commission. Referral prompts extend the appeal beyond the viewer's own tasks. The risk disclaimer does not erase those inducements: the central pitch remains a low-barrier opportunity to acquire rewards through the app. The record does not establish that any viewer lost money or that the advertised returns were paid.
